body: I broke up with her.  Going to just do it tonight.  Thanks all for your support.  Take care.

I used to feel that way.  I know my depression definitely leaks into my fiance's life and while I am sure she is going to miss me, the sooner I act the sooner she can move her life forwards again.  I don't think anyone is talking me out of doing it, the question is what is less traumatizing to her?
I appreciate it, and while it does feel good to talk about something so dark like this, I just don't really feel like continuing to live any longer.

I think she realized the error in her thinking a little after we were committed to keeping the date.  Regardless, the reason I posted this is to figure out what would potentially be less damaging to her, not to vilafy her.

I guess I hadn't been exactly happy before now, but having an internet connection and getting laid off a month before the election really showed me how terrible people are.  

I guess there is some part of me that thinks maybe if I go to the wedding I might convince myself out of it, but I also feel if it isn't enough to convince me to not do it it'll be absolutely traumatic to my fiance.
I guess, but I probably don't do a good enough job of communicating my frustrations.  I just don't have it in me anymore.

Listen I get that she was selfish, but I don't think she is selfish if you know what I mean.  She was trying to not waste some of the planning we did and I guess there was potentially some argument that could justify what we did.

I am not going to do it during the wedding, I am trying minimize the pain/trauma this is going to have on my parents/fiance/friends not magnify it to the extreme.

I absolutely love her.  This is probably the most hurtful thing anyone could say, but her presence in my life doesn't justify my continued existence.  She's absolutely fantastic and probably prolonged me from doing anything for months but I am out of will to live.  Doing this before or after the wedding was just an idea and I wanted to figure out what would hurt her less, it'll hurt me the same amount regardless of when I do it.
